name: Monitor Settings
author: Gavin Nugent
description: One panel for everything display: brightness, text size, and per-monitor resolution, refresh, scale, position, rotation, VRR and on/off — applied live via hyprctl, saved to ~/.config/hypr/monitors.conf. Replaces the first-party Display bar icon on first open. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle nosignal.monitor-settings

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Monitor Settings panel
